{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

duplicates = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(duplicates)}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check if any patient appears with multiple sample_seq
sample_seq_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique()
duplicate_sample_seqs = sample_seq_counts[sample_seq_counts > 1]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(duplicate_sample_seqs)}")

# Confirm if sample_seq is indeed 1 and 2 only
print(f"Unique sample_seq values: {df['sample_seq'].unique()}")"}
